### Module & Feature
- **Module**: Authentication, Authorization & Security Governance
- **Feature**: Email OTP Authentication (Google SMTP)
- **Estimate**: 4h
- **Dependencies**: TASK-01.1.3

### User Story Context
> As a Student/Admin/Mentor, I want to securely log in using a 6-digit OTP sent to my email via Google SMTP so that I can access my workspace without remembering passwords

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Email OTP generation (6 digits, 10-minute expiry)
- [ ] Google SMTP integration via Nodemailer for reliable OTP delivery
- [ ] JWT token generation with short-lived access tokens (15m) and secure refresh tokens (7d)
- [ ] Rate limiting on OTP dispatch (max 3 OTP requests per 15 minutes per email/IP)
